rationale: iter-86: naf_norm ln -> bn (cross-port from B/C +1.5..+1.9pp resnet breakthrough) on iter-83 substrate. Headroom 0.6057 -> 0.5845 (-2.12pp). STRONG DISCARD. BatchNorm fails on NAFNet substrate. Reason: NAFNet's LayerNorm normalizes per-position across channels; BN normalizes per-channel across batch+spatial. The block design assumes LN's per-position channel-wise normalization.
advice_for_others: STRONG DISCARD: BN on NAFNet -2.12pp. The B/C batch-norm breakthrough is resnet-specific (their convs feed into per-channel norm). NAFNet's design requires LN. Closes naf_norm axis.
